Tools in this Excellon object
when are used for drilling.
Convert the slots in the selected tools to drills.

Add/Delete a tool to the tool list
for this Excellon object.
Diameter for the new tool

Add a new tool to the tool list
with the diameter specified above.

Delete a tool in the tool list

Resize a drill or a selection of drills.
Diameter to resize to.
Resize drill(s)
Add an array of drills (linear or circular array)

Select the type of drills array to create.
It can be Linear X(Y) or Circular
Specify how many drills to be in the array.

Direction on which the linear array is oriented:
- 'X' - horizontal axis 
- 'Y' - vertical axis or 
- 'Angle' - a custom angle for the array inclination
Pitch = Distance between elements of the array.

Angle at which the linear array is placed.
The precision is of max 2 decimals.
Min value is: -360.00 degrees.
Max value is: 360.00 degrees.

Direction for circular array.
Can be CW = clockwise or CCW = counter clockwise.
Angle at which each element in circular array is placed.

Parameters for adding a slot (hole with oval shape)
either single or as an part of an array.
Length. The length of the slot.

Direction on which the slot is oriented:
- 'X' - horizontal axis 
- 'Y' - vertical axis or 
- 'Angle' - a custom angle for the slot inclination

Angle at which the slot is placed.
The precision is of max 2 decimals.
Min value is: -360.00 degrees.
Max value is: 360.00 degrees.
Parameters for the array of slots (linear or circular array)

Select the type of slot array to create.
It can be Linear X(Y) or Circular
Specify how many slots to be in the array.

Direction on which the linear array is oriented:
- 'X' - horizontal axis 
- 'Y' - vertical axis or 
- 'Angle' - a custom angle for the array inclination
Pitch = Distance between elements of the array.

Angle at which the linear array is placed.
The precision is of max 2 decimals.
Min value is: -360.00 degrees.
Max value is: 360.00 degrees.

Direction for circular array.
Can be CW = clockwise or CCW = counter clockwise.
Angle at which each element in circular array is placed.
